items.label: By train
items.content: The night train from Madrid arrives at 7:40. Book a couchette a month ahead in summer.

items.label: By air
items.content: The airport is 20 minutes from the centre by metro (line red).

items.label: By car
items.content: Parking in the old town is expensive; use the park-and-ride at Campo Grande.

items.label: Spring
items.content: Mild, green, and the best light for photographs.

items.label: Summer
items.content: Hot and busy; start early and rest at midday.
